scenario: RE2-class engine per LREG.8.4 — lookahead assertions (`(?=...)`, `(?!...)`) are not supported and must be compile errors. Pin: `/error(?=:)/` (positive lookahead) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /error(?=:)/
->
    log info "matched"
